title: Retrieve email messages that were lost by displaying 'only' unread messages.

content: I had a number of emails that were labelled 'unread'. I pulled down the command that was tagged to only show unread emails. I touched every email that was unread to get a clean plate. I have over 6K emails, but I can not get at them. Please help. George
